leaves.name: igusaGL2DSGalSome
leaves.doc: igusa-gal: Diamond-Shurman Thm 7.6.3 (first part) in its printed form: for N > 1, Gal(L_N/Q(j)) -> GL_2(Z/N) is onto, where L_N = Q(j, E_j[N]) (X1Igusa.LDS N) is the subfield of an algebraic closure of Q(j) generated by the x- and y-coordinates of the N-torsion of the universal curve E_j : y^2 = 4x^3 - g x - g, g = 27j/(j - 1728) (DS (7.12)), j transcendental: for some basis e of E_j[N] (the print fixes (P_tau, Q_tau) of (7.11)) and every g in GL_2(Z/N) some sigma_0 in Gal(L_N/Q(j)) acts on E_j[N] as g in the basis e (on L_N-points, Affine.Point.map). Implies igusaGL2DS with no hypothesis (X1Igusa.igusaGL2DS_of_igusaGL2DSGalSome: one basis gives every basis by conjugation in GL_2(Z/N) (igusaGL2DSGal_of_some), then liftNormal to Aut(Q(j)bar/Q(j)), IsAlgClosure.normal, liftNormal_commutes; N = 1 directly). Pages read by igusa-gal: Thm 7.6.3 p. 290 (2005) / p. 294 (2016); rho p. 287 / p. 291; (7.12) p. 282 / p. 286.
leaves.flag: pending review (inbox 43: new leaf, GLUE until the reviewer rates it; source: cited print, Diamond-Shurman Thm 7.6.3, not in diophantine_zq.tex) unread: new printed leaf (no human reading); AI page check (igusa-gal, 11-17) in the 2005 and 2016 printings: Thm 7.6.3 p. 290 / p. 294; rho is the action of Gal(Q(j,E_j[N])/Q(j)) on E_j[N] in the ordered basis (P_tau, Q_tau) of (7.11), p. 287 / p. 291 (as in Cor 7.5.3, p. 284 / p. 288), stated for one basis as printed (the every-basis form is proved in Lean, igusaGL2DSGal_of_some); N > 1 (standing assumption opening section 7.5, p. 279 / p. 283), the leaf assumes 1 < N; E_j of (7.12) p. 282 / p. 286 with j transcendental, points in Q(j)bar^2 (p. 287 / p. 291), Q(j, E_j[N]) generated by x(E_j[N]) and y(E_j[N]) (p. 283 / p. 287); chord-tangent group law with origin [0,1,0] (section 7.1, pp. 253-254 / pp. 257-258)
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, A First Course in Modular Forms, GTM 228 (2005), Theorem 7.6.3 (p. 290; 2016 printing p. 294), rho defined p. 287 (2016: p. 291), universal curve (7.12) p. 282 (2016: p. 286); Igusa, Amer. J. Math. 81 (1959) (unread)
